visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white blazer sits in a bright indoor studio-like setting with a laptop and various objects on shelves behind her. She speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face and hand gestures. A large text overlay at the top introduces the PeNi mattress. (2) A man in a dark green t-shirt and grey shorts lies flat on a grey star-patterned mattress placed on a light wooden floor. He gives a thumbs up with both hands while someone else's hands also give a thumbs up in the frame. (3) Close-up shots show hands squeezing the thick, mesh-like material of the mattress, demonstrating its elasticity and thickness. An infographic appears on screen showing the internal X shaped structure and text explaining its breathability and support features. (4) The man is seen on the floor rolling up the thin mattress into a compact cylindrical shape. This demonstrates the product's portability. The background consists of light wood flooring and the bottom edge of a wooden cabinet. (5) A young child is seen sitting in a black baby stroller, using a purple and white cooling mat. The shot is a medium close-up, showing the child's face and the mat's placement. Infographics highlight different use cases like car seats and high chairs.
